messages.subject: Your Porn Fetch license
messages.body:
Your license file {filename} is attached. Save it and import it in Porn Fetch’s license activation screen.

Your lifetime Premium license never expires. Use Premium on up to ten active installations. Every future Porn Fetch update and feature I release is included. Future development has no guaranteed duration. Activation and periodic online validation are required. If I permanently close the licensing service, I will provide an offline unlock before closure so existing buyers can continue using Premium.

Patreon Shop is a one-time purchase; no recurring membership is required.
